messages.en: I find that message hard to believe. Is the office really closed tomorrow?
I've checked the official website. The office is open as usual.
We want to defend our title this year, right? Let's practise this afternoon.
Of course! See you at the field at five, okay?

senses.en_definition: To have or possess something, or to have a particular quality, ability, or relationship.

messages.en: I want to apply for this job, but the ad says applicants need at least two years of work experience. I've only been working for a year.
Try asking HR first. Would they count your internship experience too?
Oh yeah, I did a six-month internship before. Okay, I'll ask them.
Who's going to play the drum tonight? I've brought it along.
I can. Let's play softly to start with, okay?
